messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Reserved GPU pool 'resv-west-3' at 100% reserved utilization. Throttling observed for enterprise tenant @OrchidBank. Autoscaler failed to add nodes due to quota limit. Severity: P1. Runbook: /runbooks/reserved-pool-exhaustion
santiago: I'm on it, grabbing metrics. seeing queue growth on q:resv-west-3-enterprise (QPS +420%).
priya: autoscaler logs show repeated 403 from cloud API: quotaExceeded -> hit vGPU quota for that account. timeline ~03:12 UTC
jen: can we temporarily move OrchidBank to fallback routing to hosted tier? that would cost but reduce customer impact.
matt: support on standby, I'll draft message to OrchidBank CSM while we triage.
luis: please cc me, I'll join the bridge after 5 min.
santiago: mitigation proposals: 1) evict noisy long-running sessions in pool (graceful), 2) manual scale override if infra quota allows, 3) route OrchidBank to hosted fallback per jen
priya: trying eviction script now: `./tools/evict_long_sessions --pool resv-west-3 --limit 20` will evict sessions >8h
santiago: running it... output:
```
evict_long_sessions: scanned 1200 sessions, evicted 18 (oldest 10h12m)
post-evict pool utilization -> 98%
queue length dropped from 420 -> 210
```
priya: queue reduced but still high. autoscaler still blocked by quota. need manual cloud quota increase from infra or route.
jen: @infra-team is taking calls on quota increases; tagging them in the bridge. but ETA unknown.
matt: drafted customer note: "we're seeing elevated latency and throttling on your reserved capacity; engineering is mitigating, we may failover traffic to hosted temporarily. Will update in 15m." should I send now?
luis: hold, wait for routing confirmation. send if we hit 5m more with no improvement.
priya: found hotspot: 1 tenant job causing bursts — session_id 8f4b... generating persistent batch jobs. marking as noisy.
santiago: can we target eviction to that tenant only? run selective kill.
priya: yes: `./tools/evict_sessions --pool resv-west-3 --tenant OrchidBank --threshold 6h` -> evicting 9 sessions
```
Selective eviction complete. pool utilization -> 96%
queue -> 70
latency 95p reduced ~320ms
```
santiago: that's better. still above SLO for some endpoints but avoiding customer failover.
jen: temporary rate-limit increase for hosted fallback route configured in case we need it. config snippet:
```
route.fallback.resv-west-3:
  enabled: true
  max_redirect_rps: 250
```
matt: sending delayed update to customer now. short and transparent.
matt: sent: "Update: We mitigated noisy sessions and reduced throttling. Some latency persists, we will continue to monitor. — Redwood Support"
luis: confirm CSM pinged.
santiago: monitoring queue and autoscaler. if queue < 50 we can close pager. re-evaluating in 10m.
incident-bot: Alert: queue length falling, now 34. CPU-GPU utilization 94%.
priya: autoscaler still shows quota error. opened quick cloud ticket with infra (#INC-8421) and escalated to oncall infra.
jen: infra oncall (mike) replied: "we can request quota bump but approval ~30-60m, recommending continued eviction + routing." mike also suggested enabling short-lived burst nodes if account policy allows.
santiago: plan: 1) monitor 15m, 2) keep targeted evictions, 3) have hosted fallback ready, 4) customer updates every 15m. If queue rises >200, trigger failover.
matt: noted. prepping post-incident summary draft.
luis: thanks team. I'll stay on the bridge while you watch metrics.
santiago: closing pager in 20m if stable. thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager resolved: queue < 50 for 15m, closed at 1736000450.
